reason: My Notes app already does my grocery list and money notes, and it's free and I never have to check anything. I might try the free version once out of curiosity, but I'm not paying $6 a month when I make like $2,000 a year.
objection: Will the AI actually read my receipt right, or am I going to end up fixing every line? If I have to check and correct it anyway, typing it into Notes is faster.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it read a crumpled corner-store receipt perfectly on the first try, and the free tier being enough that I never hit a paywall.
